raw_context:
Apria
most commonly refers to
Apria Healthcare
, a major American provider of home medical equipment and clinical services like oxygen and sleep apnea therapy. It can also be used as a rare given name meaning "sunny" or "from the apricot", or as an acronym in arts research.
Ancestry
Apria Healthcare
Core Services:
Supplies home respiratory therapy, sleep apnea treatment (CPAP/BiPAP), negative pressure wound therapy, and diabetes care.
Operations:
Serves millions of patients across the United States through hundreds of local branch locations.
Official Site:
You can find patient resources and contact details on the
Apria Official Website
Alternative Meanings
Given Name:
A modern American or Latin-derived female first name meaning "sunny," "warm," or related to the apricot fruit.
Academic Platform:
Stands for platforms like
Artistic Research Platform in the Arts
(APRIA), used for publishing creative and academic research.
